entities.name: Jérôme Beau

entities.summary: Jérôme Daniel Beau is a French Catholic bishop. He previously served as the Archbishop of Bourges From 2018 to 2025. He also served as the Auxiliary Bishop of Paris from 2006 to 2018. On 14 January 2025, he was appointed as the Metropolitan Archbishop of Poitiers, succeeding Pascal Wintzer.
